title: [auto-fix] Accept rvalue-reference-qualified function types in the demangler.
description:
ParseFunctionType currently consumes only the lvalue ref qualifier R. The ABI also permits O for an rvalue ref qualifier, which appears in both failing mangled names. Accept either qualifier while preserving the existing output behavior.

Reproduced failing tests:
- `Demangle.ReferenceQualifiedFunctionTypes`
